about.title: Strength, nourishment, and a quiet kind of confidence.
about.calling: We all have a calling in life. My calling is to help people.
about.story: After my study at SNF Academy, where I studied Personal Trainer and Nutrition coach, and graduating from Awakening School of Ministry, I help people move forward in their lives. With the right diet, the right mindset, and the right exercise. At any age.

howIWork.title: Six weeks, and what actually happens in them.
howIWork.intro: No mystery about the method. This is the sequence every program follows, so you know what you are saying yes to before you say it.

step1.title: The first conversation
step1.body: No script, no sales call. You tell me where you are, what you have already tried, and what you want the next months to feel like. I ask questions. At the end we both know whether this is a fit — and if it isn't, I will say so.

step2.title: Your starting point
step2.body: Before anything gets planned, we look at what is actually there: how you move today, how you eat in a normal week, what your schedule really allows, and any injury or limit I need to design around.

step3.title: The plan, in writing
step3.body: You get your training and nutrition plan written down, built for the week you have rather than an ideal one. We meet one-on-one every week, and between sessions you can send me form videos and questions.

step4.title: Adjusting as we go
step4.body: A plan that survives contact with a real week is the only kind worth having. Each week we look at what worked and what didn't, and adjust — load, meals, or expectations. By week six you should be able to run it without me.

mission.title: Your best years are not behind you — they're the ones you're about to create.
mission.p1: It's never too late for change and improvement. It's all up to you. Every day is a new opportunity to start a fulfilling life where you feel your best. The most important thing is to decide not to give up and start doing.
mission.p2: Do you want to lose weight? Or do you want more muscle? Or do you want to eat and live healthier, but you're not sure how? Or has life exhausted you spiritually and mentally?
mission.p3: Let me tell you. It's never too late.
mission.p4: And I will do my best to help you.

faq.title: Honest answers, before you commit.
faq.intro: Still wondering something not listed here? Send it along when you reach out — that's what the first conversation is for.

believer.q: Do I have to be a believer to work with you?
believer.a: No. The spiritual mentoring is offered, never required. The Training Only and Training + Nutrition programs work for anyone, regardless of faith background. The Complete program is built for those specifically wanting that dimension included.

women.a: It's built with women in mind first — but men are openly welcome, especially in the training and nutrition programs. The Complete program works for anyone willing to be honest about all three areas.

how.q: How does a program actually work?
how.a: We start with a free, no-pressure conversation to make sure we're a good fit. After that, you receive your personalized plan, we meet weekly (online or in person), and you have me as a guide through the whole six weeks.

gym.q: Do I need a gym membership?
gym.a: Not for most programs. I design the training around what you have access to — home, gym, or somewhere in between. We can talk this through when you reach out.

beginner.q: What if I haven't trained in years — or ever?
beginner.a: That's most of who I work with. Everything is built around your starting point. No prerequisites, no judgment. The goal is sustainable progress, not punishment.
